## Canonical site commands

Reusable Fusion site commands live in this package:

- `send_bulk_emails`
- `verify_content`
- `populate_content`
- `populate_courses`
- `populate_homepage`

Projects expose these commands through thin `apps.core.management.commands`
wrappers. Keep site-specific model resolution deferred until command execution;
do not duplicate the command implementations in individual apps.
